_comment: RViT+ V8_part3 configuration. CONV-FREE, RL-ONLY. v8's H1-residual cross-attention encoder kept verbatim (Q = patch tokens X; K=V = [X ++ H1 ++ H2] memory-as-tokens; block-0 residual = carried H1) with THREE additions: (1) a PREDICTIVE-COMPARATOR write gate — a tiny forward model predicts the attention output Z from the carried deep memory H2; the detached prediction-error 'surprise' opens a learnable gate g that scales the LSTM2 input by (1+g), rewriting the evolving codebook H2 harder where the frame surprises the stored prediction (g≈0 at init = exact v8; self-supervised next-Z loss = pred_loss_coef); (2) a learnable-gain H1 residual (init 1.0 = exact v8); (3) the 1D-conv actor/critic heads read H1‖H2 (both LSTM states), not just H2. Training = PAC (MPO+BC) + distributional QR-DQN + prioritized episode replay + the comparator's self-supervised loss + a small always-wait-harbor penalty (harbor_coef). The evolving codebook is LEVERAGED, never frozen (no VQ). Priority for any setting: CLI arg > this config > script-hardcoded default.

run._note_init_mode: fresh = random init (checkpoint_path ignored); warm_start = partial load (skip name/shape mismatches silently); resume = strict load (fail on any mismatch). v8_part3 is a new architecture (comparator write gate + H1‖H2 readout) — starts fresh.
run._note_checkpoint_location: checkpoint_dir points OUTSIDE the repo (~/rvit_plus_checkpoints/v8_part3) on purpose: the AttentionManuscript repo is a Google Drive sync root and Drive was observed rewriting checkpoints mid-session, which can corrupt a run. Keep live checkpoints in a non-synced home dir.

environment._comment: ChangeDetectionEnv parameters — matched to the v3/HRA defaults for apples-to-apples comparison.

model._comment: Conv-free patch + cross-attention-over-memory block (8 heads) + 2 stacked per-token LSTMs + 1D-conv actor/critic heads.
model._note_patch: patch_size must divide the 50x50 image: {1,2,5,10,25,50}. patch_size=5 → 10x10 grid = 100 tokens (each 25x25 Gabor quadrant = a 5x5 patch block).
model._note_patch_hidden: The raw flattened patch is small (patch_dim = C*p*p = 3*5*5 = 75). A per-patch MLP (Linear→GELU→Linear→LayerNorm) of hidden width patch_hidden expands it up to d_model. Default 128 = d_model.
model._note_d_model: d_model = transformer/token width; d_mem = LSTM hidden = recurrent-state width the heads read. MUST be equal (128): memory (H1,H2) is concatenated into the d_model token stream as cross-attention keys/values. LSTM1 ingests the d_model attention output Z; later LSTMs ingest the previous d_mem hidden.
model._note_tx: The encoder is tx_layers cross-attention block(s) (default 1) with tx_heads=8: queries from the 100 patch tokens X, keys/values from [X ++ H1 ++ H2] = 3*n_tokens tokens (memory-as-tokens; H1,H2 = previous-frame LSTM states, tagged by source + a shared memory positional embedding). With only N queries, the output Z is (B,n_tokens,d_model) — no slice-from-3N needed (contrast v5 memtok).
model._note_n_lstm: Number of stacked per-token LSTMs after the transformer = number of recurrent memory states. n_lstm=2: Z→LSTM1→H1→LSTM2→H2, each (B,n_tokens,d_mem) carried across frames. The heads read the TOP state H2.
model._note_head: Actor & critic decoders are 1D-CONV: each arranges the top state H2 as (B, d_mem channels, n_tokens length) and runs n_conv_layers stride-2 Conv1d layers (kernel conv_kernel, conv_channels each) over the TOKEN axis, then flattens + Linear to the outputs. This PRESERVES the spatial token layout (an earlier mean-pool variant discarded it and didn't learn). No CLS, no action-as-input encoding. Final Linear small-init'd; actor init_action_bias on its bias. With n_tokens=100/3 stride-2 layers the token axis is 100→50→25→13.
model._note_rl_heads: Actor logits (B,n_actions) + distributional critic Q (B,n_actions,n_quantiles), each from H2 via a SEPARATE Conv1d-over-tokens trunk → flatten → Linear. init_action_bias = [wait_bias, press_bias]; [0.0,-1.5] gives initial P(press)≈0.18.

ppo._comment: PAC actor loss (MPO E-step + BC) + distributional QR-DQN critic + prioritized episode replay. RL ONLY — no recon, no PC, no pretrain.
ppo._note_v8part3_coefs: v8_part3 PPOConfig defaults (used unless overridden): pred_loss_coef=0.1 (weight on the comparator's self-supervised next-Z prediction loss, reward-independent so the forward model learns even on the saturated ~1-2 bit task), harbor_coef=0.01 (small penalty on P(wait) mass, ACTOR phase only, to close the always-wait safe harbor; monitor premature_rate). These are documentation; the values live in ppo.PPOConfig.
ppo._note_pac_actor: PAC (Springenberg, Abdolmaleki et al., DeepMind 2024) REPLACES PPO's clipped surrogate. Discrete MPO E-step is closed-form: q(a|s) = softmax_a[ log π_old(a|s) + Q̄(s,a)/η ]; M-step + BC blend gives L_actor = (1−α)·[−Σ_a q(a|s)·log π_θ(a|s)] + α·[−log π_θ(a_t|s)]. η = mpo_temperature, α = bc_alpha.
ppo._note_target_network: PAC target network θ' (Springenberg et al. 2024, §3.2): the critic's distributional TD target AND the MPO E-step reference policy π_θ' BOTH come from a periodically hard-copied, time-lagged copy of θ. target_update_period = hard-copy θ→θ' every N optimizer steps; 0 disables (online bootstrap). The main stabilizer for the bootstrapped actor-critic; was missing in the original implementation.
ppo._note_burn_in: Burn-in / wait-pretrain (v3's recon_pretrain_iters, restored 2026-06-06). For the first burn_in_iters iterations the agent is FORCED to wait (action=0) so episodes run full-length, and only the critic is trained with the actor FROZEN at init — warming up the value function and recurrent representation on clean full trajectories before the policy acts. v5 has no decoder/recon (and no contrastive), so the critic/representation warm up alone. 0 disables.
ppo._note_per: Prioritized episode replay (Schaul et al. 2016, episode-level). Fresh on-policy episodes are augmented with per_n_replay replay episodes sampled ∝ priority^per_alpha (priority = mean per-step quantile-Huber error, clipped at per_priority_clip×median). IS weights (1/(N·p))^β with β annealed per_beta_start→per_beta_end over the run. per_n_replay=0 disables replay.
